mapper.select: SELECT period AS "period", SUM(amount) AS "amount" FROM bi_fact_purchase WHERE period >= #{fromPeriod} GROUP BY period ORDER BY period

SELECT f.period AS "period", SUM(CASE WHEN a.code LIKE '60%' OR a.code LIKE '63%' THEN f.credit - f.debit ELSE 0 END) AS "revenue", SUM(CASE WHEN a.code LIKE '64%' OR a.code LIKE '66%' OR a.code LIKE '67%' OR a.code LIKE '68%' THEN f.debit - f.credit ELSE 0 END) AS "expense" FROM bi_fact_finance f JOIN fin_account a ON a.id = f.account_id WHERE f.period >= #{fromPeriod} AND f.category = 'PROFIT' GROUP BY f.period ORDER BY f.period

SELECT f.customer_id AS "id", c.name AS "name", SUM(f.amount) AS "amount", SUM(f.profit) AS "profit" FROM bi_fact_sales f JOIN scm_customer c ON c.id = f.customer_id WHERE f.biz_date >= #{from} GROUP BY f.customer_id, c.name ORDER BY SUM(f.amount) DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT f.material_id AS "id", m.name AS "name", SUM(f.qty) AS "qty", SUM(f.amount) AS "amount" FROM bi_fact_sales f JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = f.material_id WHERE f.biz_date >= #{from} GROUP BY f.material_id, m.name ORDER BY SUM(f.amount) DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT COALESCE(category, '') AS "category", SUM(qty) AS "qty", SUM(amount) AS "amount", CAST(MAX(snap_date) AS CHAR(10)) AS "snapDate" FROM bi_fact_inventory WHERE snap_date = (SELECT MAX(snap_date) FROM bi_fact_inventory) GROUP BY category ORDER BY SUM(amount) DESC

SELECT (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount - settled_amount), 0) FROM fin_bill WHERE kind = 'AR') AS "arBalance", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount - settled_amount), 0) FROM fin_bill WHERE kind = 'AR' AND status <> 'SETTLED' AND due_date < #{today}) AS "arOverdue", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount - settled_amount), 0) FROM fin_bill WHERE kind = 'AP') AS "apBalance", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.price * GREATEST(i.qty - i.done_qty + i.replenish_qty, 0)), 0) FROM scm_order o JOIN scm_order_item i ON i.order_id = o.id WHERE o.kind = 'SALES' AND o.status IN ('APPROVED', 'PARTIAL')) AS "openSalesAmount", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_work_order WHERE status IN ('RELEASED', 'STARTED')) AS "openWorkOrders", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_work_order WHERE status IN ('RELEASED', 'STARTED') AND plan_end < #{today}) AS "lateWorkOrders", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM pm_project WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS "activeProjects", (SELECT AVG(progress) FROM pm_project WHERE status = 'ACTIVE') AS "projectProgress", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM hr_employee WHERE status <> 'LEFT') AS "headcount", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount), 0) FROM crm_opportunity WHERE stage NOT IN ('WON', 'LOST')) AS "pipeline", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_ticket WHERE status IN ('OPEN', 'PROCESSING')) AS "openTickets", (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_ticket WHERE status IN ('OPEN', 'PROCESSING') AND due_time < #{now}) AS "overdueTickets"

SELECT f.material_id AS "materialId", m.code AS "code", m.name AS "name", m.category AS "category", SUM(f.qty) AS "qty", SUM(f.cost) AS "cost", SUM(f.amount) AS "amount" FROM bi_fact_sales f JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = f.material_id WHERE f.biz_date >= #{from} GROUP BY f.material_id, m.code, m.name, m.category HAVING SUM(f.amount) > 0

SELECT s.material_id AS "materialId", m.code AS "code", m.name AS "name", m.category AS "category", m.unit AS "unit", SUM(s.qty) AS "qty", (SELECT CAST(MAX(f.create_time) AS CHAR(19)) FROM wms_stock_flow f WHERE f.material_id = s.material_id AND f.qty < 0 AND f.biz_type <> 'TRANSFER') AS "lastOut", (SELECT CAST(MIN(f.create_time) AS CHAR(19)) FROM wms_stock_flow f WHERE f.material_id = s.material_id AND f.qty > 0) AS "firstIn", (SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.amount), 0) FROM bi_fact_inventory i WHERE i.material_id = s.material_id AND i.snap_date = (SELECT MAX(snap_date) FROM bi_fact_inventory)) AS "amount" FROM wms_stock s JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = s.material_id GROUP BY s.material_id, m.code, m.name, m.category, m.unit HAVING SUM(s.qty) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wms_stock_flow f WHERE f.material_id = s.material_id AND f.qty < 0 AND f.biz_type <> 'TRANSFER' AND f.create_time >= #{since})

choose.when: SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount - settled_amount), 0) FROM fin_bill WHERE kind = 'AR' AND status <> 'SETTLED' AND due_date < #{today}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM wms_material m WHERE m.status = 1 AND m.safety_stock > 0 AND COALESCE((SELECT SUM(s.qty) FROM wms_stock s WHERE s.material_id = m.id), 0) < m.safety_stock

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ( SELECT s.material_id FROM wms_stock s GROUP BY s.material_id HAVING SUM(s.qty) > 0 AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM wms_stock_flow f WHERE f.material_id = s.material_id AND f.qty < 0 AND f.biz_type <> 'TRANSFER' AND f.create_time >= #{since})) t
SELECT CASE WHEN SUM(amount) > 0 THEN SUM(profit) * 100 / SUM(amount) END FROM bi_fact_sales WHERE period = #{period}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM crm_ticket WHERE status IN ('OPEN', 'PROCESSING') AND due_time < #{now}
choose.otherwise: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mes_work_order WHERE status IN ('RELEASED', 'STARTED') AND plan_end < #{today}
